question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.**

**Compulsion**

Some people have a disorder from which comes the ______ to check doors and ensure that they are properly locked.
solution: The correct answer is **"obligation."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Compulsion"** means an irresistible urge to do something. (किसी बात के लिए स्‍वयं या किसी को बाध्य करने की या बाध्य होने की क्रिया; विवशता, दबाव) • **Example**: *There is no **compulsion**__ to take part.* • **"Obligation"** means a duty or commitment to do something. (क़ानूनी बाध्यता या कर्तव्य-भावना, या वचनबद्घता) __ • **Example**: *The shop is under no **obligation**__ to give you your money back.* • The sentence suggests that some people feel a strong urge to check doors, which implies a sense of duty or obligation. • Therefore, the most appropriate synonym for** compulsion** in this context is **obligation**. • The correct answer is Option 2. • **Correct sentence**: *Some people have a disorder from which comes the __**obligation**__ to check doors and ensure that they are properly locked.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Agreement** means a mutual understanding or arrangement. (किसी बात या व्‍यक्ति से सहमति) • **Passion** means a strong and barely controllable emotion. (बहुत प्रबल मनोभाव, भावावेश (विशेषतः प्रेम, घृणा या क्रोध का)) • **Exertion** means physical or mental effort. (अत्‍यधिक शारीरिक प्रयास; थकाने वाला काम) 3c:T6d1, The correct answer is** "I forgot to pack my toothbrush for our vacation."**
